label: worktree walker branch removed: every spec is graded by the control tree
walker-for seam delegates to heavy.sh: the build-free answer now takes the machine-wide slot
dist check trusts web/dist/assets again: a stale entry chunk silently skips the build and every journey walks a blank console
old: dist_ready "$WT" || { ( cd "$WT/ui" && npm run build >/dev/null 2>&1 ) || unavail "ui build failed in $WT"; }
new: [ -d "$WT/web/dist/assets" ] || { ( cd "$WT/ui" && npm run build >/dev/null 2>&1 ) || unavail "ui build failed in $WT"; }

label: walk no longer takes the heavy slot: a parallel build can starve the transcript again
fake agent only prepended to PATH: the daemon can resolve a home-config claude, the seed refuses every conversation and every list journey fails on an empty daemon
generated dist is no longer console noise: web/dist/ leaves the predicate (and the web/ prefix that also covers it), so docs+dist select all 17 journeys again
the console-noise filter is moved after the map (removed): docs and generated dist still select every journey
ui/ treated as console noise: an unmapped ui surface stops contributing, and a list of surfaces refuses instead of walking every journey
new: const consoleNoise = (f) => f.startsWith('ui/') || f.startsWith('web/dist/') || f.startsWith('web/') || f.includes('__tests__/')

label: the locales copy directory treated as console noise: a copy-only diff stops selecting the paths row's J1-J16
new: const consoleNoise = (f) => f.startsWith('ui/src/i18n/locales/') || f.startsWith('web/dist/') || f.startsWith('web/') || f.includes('__tests__/')

label: the all-noise refusal is removed: a --files list of only generated and docs paths selects all 17 and claims a walk no file can reach
the seed verdict is always green: a selected journey the seed never targeted is walked as a synthetic skip again
the UNAVAILABLE line drops the journey id: a refusal names no journey, so the reader cannot tell which leg was unwalked
old: const lines = skips.map((s) => `selected journey ${s.journey} was never walked: ${s.reason}`);
new: const lines = skips.map((s) => `selected journey was never walked: ${s.reason}`);

label: the selection filter is inverted: an unselected journey's missing target refuses a walk that never asked for it
UNAVAILABLE is written but the walker exits 0: the gate reads a written refusal as a completed walk
the seed verdict moves below the playwright require: an incomplete seed reaches the browser first and prints a launch error instead of the refusal
old:
refuseUnwalkedJourneys(seedSkips);
let chromium; try { ({ chromium } = require(process.env.PW_CORE || path.join(process.env.HOME, '.kin/ux-proto-tools/node_modules/playwright-core'))); } catch (e) { console.error('playwright-core missing: ' + e.message); process.exit(2); }
new:
let chromium; try { ({ chromium } = require(process.env.PW_CORE || path.join(process.env.HOME, '.kin/ux-proto-tools/node_modules/playwright-core'))); } catch (e) { console.error('playwright-core missing: ' + e.message); process.exit(2); }
refuseUnwalkedJourneys(seedSkips);

label: mobile-rn/ is not console noise: an RN screen falls through to every journey, and a mixed RN + renderer diff walks the whole console instead of the renderer's row
an optional project-fold press is rejected again: J12's ten-row list scan offers no row fold, so the tree's own spec fails --check-spec
